items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Hill was the manager of the club at that time and that was an old band buddy of yours.

ctx.x: I didn't have no feeling. Just as light, just like walking on cotton, just feel nothing.

When you mentioned about all of the junkies around Minton's and whatnot, how about the music that they played? Teddy Hill was the manager of the club at that time and that was an old band buddy of yours. Like you say, you were living right here, right up the street.
Yeah, but I don't know, I didn't care too much about it.
